title: Credentials
subtitle: Auth tokens for HTTP requests — attached automatically when the URL matches the host in the pattern.
security_note: Tokens NEVER appear in the LLM context or tool results. They are only injected server-side as headers when fetch_url targets a matching URL.
name: Name
name_invalid: Invalid — only a-z, 0-9, _ and -, max 50 chars.
value_hint_bearer: E.g. an API token. Sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <value>'.
url_pattern_hint: Pattern with a concrete host, e.g. 'https://api.example.com/*' or 'https://*.example.com/*'. Only then is the secret attached. fetch_url never uses '*' (all URLs).
ssh_private_key_hint: OpenSSH or PEM format. Stored encrypted, never passed to the agent.
ssh_host_hint: Host the agent should SSH into.
ssh_host_invalid: Only letters, digits, dots and hyphens allowed (max 253 chars).
ssh_user_invalid: Only letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens allowed (max 32 chars).
url_pattern_wildcard_warning: This pattern names no concrete host, so fetch_url never attaches this secret — not even when an agent asks for it by name. Enter the host it is meant for.
not_host_bound: No host — fetch_url never attaches it
unbound_banner_one: {{count}} secret without a concrete host is never attached by fetch_url. Open it and enter the host it is meant for.
unbound_banner_other: {{count}} secrets without a concrete host are never attached by fetch_url. Open them and enter the host each is meant for.
